title: Using plural demonstratives without a noun
focus: Let nämä, nuo, or ne stand independently for several identifiable referents.

exercises.instruction: Write the complete sentence in Finnish.
exercises.prompt: Write “Those are here.” in Finnish. While comparing two photos. No noun follows the demonstrative. Use täällä (“here”). The referents are already identifiable from the conversation.
exercises.explanation: Ne stands independently and takes the plural verb ovat.

sentenceExplanation.pattern: independent plural demonstrative subject + linking verb + location

exercises.prompt: Choose the sentence that means “Those are inside.” During a house tour. No noun follows the demonstrative. Use sisällä (“inside”). The referents are already identifiable from the conversation.
exercises.explanation: Ne stands independently and takes the plural verb ovat.

sentenceExplanation.pattern: independent plural demonstrative subject + linking verb + location

Correct. Ne stands independently and takes the plural verb ovat.
“esineet” is not the required form here; use “ovat”, the plural affirmative form of olla.
“on” is the singular affirmative form of olla; use “ovat”, the plural affirmative form of olla.
